n3ac9ca35a0.headline: AMLO blames Pemex deficit on FCH and EPN
n3ac9ca35a0.summary: Mexican President Andrés Manuel López Obrador attributed Pemex's crude oil production deficit affecting its finances to the administrations of Felipe Calderón and Enrique Peña Nieto.
n3ac9ca35a0.why: Pemex is Mexico's state oil company, critical to the country's economy; production deficits impact fiscal revenues and energy sector stability.
